caption: The drawing depicts a small wooden table with an octagonal top surface featuring visible wood grain and a subtle starburst pattern. The table has two drawers on the front, each with a round brass pull handle and a keyhole at the center. Below the drawers, there is a gathered and draped light-colored fabric with a faint, swirling floral pattern, suspended in a pouch-like form. The table stands on four tall, slender, turned legs, which are also made of wood and taper slightly toward the bottom. The overall color palette consists of different shades of brown for the wooden elements and a grayish or off-white color for the hanging fabric. The background is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the detailed rendering and textures of the table and its components.
title: Sewing Table
